column1: # Generated by `py -3.14 tools/pointer_census.py`; do not edit. Code-side addresses that no
# relocation covers in the source-only build. status: object_numeric = a compiled unit
# object encodes the address as a number (asm operand, .word, numeric C); retail_game /
# retail_sdk = the code is still retail bytes there (unselected function), so every
# reference it makes is a number (retail_sdk: the PsyQ .LIB link will relocate it).
# kind: hi16_lo16 (address = the lui; extra names the lo), j26, jal26, gprel16 (gp-relative,
# moves with sdata/sbss), branch_xfunc (pc-relative branch into another function), word.
